Complete SFT identification of Smithium requires the conjunction of (i) Z/N, (ii) A, (iii) genetically linked decay, (iv) ion/oxidation identity and (v) spectroscopic class, with source custody for every record. This is a deliberately stronger complete-project protocol, not a claim that IUPAC requires all five for priority recognition. Current status remains an unobserved standing prediction.
